titles: Optus facing class action over alleged customer privacy breaches | The incident reported at the original URL concerns a **data breach at Optus** that occurred prior to April 2020, involving the exposure of personal information of approximately **50,000 customers** due to a system error that resulted in their details being published in the White Pages directory against their wishes[4][2][3]. This breach led to a **class action lawsuit** seeking compensation for affected customers, marking the first such privacy-related class action against an Australian telecommunications provider[4][2][5].
